basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Austin, Texas. I recently adopted a cat named Luna, and she has been a delightful addition to my life. I enjoy exploring new hobbies and recently took an interest in learning about different cultures, which led me to be fascinated by places like Tanzania. During the weekdays, my work keeps me busy, but I often find time to browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. I'm single and live alone, which gives me a lot of flexibility to engage with online communities. My typical online hours are late nights and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design. Most of my knowledge comes from formal education and practical work experience, but I'm also a self-learner who enjoys reading articles and watching tutorials online. My interest in ADHD led me to explore the TwoXADHD subreddit for firsthand experiences and advice.
